# Alpenlume

> Small iPhone and iPad apps that each do one thing, with no account, no ads, no tracking and no server: everything stays on the device.

## Apps

- [Talkquote](https://alpenlume.github.io/talkquote.html): Quotations by voice
- [Voucherlume](https://alpenlume.github.io/voucherlume.html): Every card, one wallet
- [Sublume](https://alpenlume.github.io/sublume.html): What it all costs
- [Filmlume](https://alpenlume.github.io/filmlume.html): Film negatives, into photos
- [Meterlume](https://alpenlume.github.io/meterlume.html): Film light meter · 35 mm and 120
- [Weddinglume](https://alpenlume.github.io/weddinglume.html): A wedding, wherever it is held
- [DocuLume Pro](https://alpenlume.github.io/doculume.html): Docs, PDF, scan
- [Fornela](https://alpenlume.github.io/fornela.html): Kitchen and shopping
- [Sharpfield](https://alpenlume.github.io/sharpfield-full-frame.html): Full frame optics
- [Melopocket](https://alpenlume.github.io/melopocket.html): Music and podcasts

Support: alpenlume@gmail.com
Prices are shown in the App Store, in the buyer's currency.
